title: Chapter 1222
text:
Event 1: The third book review event. Event period starts today and ends on March 30th. Fan value must be greater than that of apprentices, otherwise, it will be invalid.

It's another spring season. Unknowingly, Master Gichy has already been with us for three years. Regarding this, please use 'The Days I Spent with the Super Godly Mechanic' as the title. There are no restrictions on the number of words or the style.

Note: The title of the book review for this event must be 'My Days with the Legendary Mechanic'. Otherwise, it will be invalid.

The event rewards are as follows:

First Place: 22888 (all units are in Qidian Coins)

Second Place: 12000

Third Place: 10000

Fourth Place: 8000

Fifth Place: 5000

Sixth to Tenth Place: 3000

Eleventh to Fifteenth Place: 2000

Three Consolation Prizes: 1000

Most Lame Book Award: 4088

In addition, there are five lucky readers who will receive exclusive titles.

Event 2: The fourth book building event. Event period starts today and ends on March 30th. Fan value must be greater than that of apprentices, otherwise, it will be invalid.
